assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-quality transparent PNG character cutout for a fantasy-hockey comedy website; one default pose in a reusable character set.
Primary request: A charismatic, unmistakably ROBOT version of elderly Canadian hockey commentator Don Cherry, recognizable caricature likeness, designed as a premium stylized 3D broadcast puppet. Stocky broad shoulders, recognizable long face and prominent nose, heavy expressive white metal eyebrows, brushed silver swept-back hair at sides with receding crown, small sculpted white-silver chin goatee. Face is ivory enamel and brushed aluminum with tasteful articulated seams at cheeks and a hinged mouth; expressive pale-blue optical eyes with pupils. Clearly a charming mechanical robot, not a person wearing a robot helmet. Exposed engineered neck and robotic hands.
Costume: flamboyant cherry-red tailored jacket with ornate large gold-and-ivory floral brocade, wide lapels, crisp white shirt, deep navy tie with gold diagonal stripes, white pocket square, tiny black clip-on lapel microphone. Keep the elaborate jacket elegant and readable, no text or logos.
Pose: DEFAULT / LISTENING. Upright relaxed seated-style waist-up posture, facing the camera, mouth fully closed, self-assured mildly stern face, both relaxed mechanical hands visible near the lower torso. No pointing yet.
Composition/framing: single character only on a square 2048x2048 canvas, front camera at face height, medium waist-up portrait. Center the head at x=50%, eyes near y=28%, head top at y=9%, shoulders around y=42%, waist ends at y=92%. Include entire arms and hands and leave generous transparent room at both sides for later gesture variants. Subject fully inside frame; straight unobtrusive waist cutoff above the bottom edge. This exact camera, scale, body anchor and costume must support later crossfaded pose variants.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished high-end stylized 3D character render, witty editorial caricature, sophisticated physical materials, precise seams, soft studio key and fill lighting, clean silhouette, lively readable face even at 300px display height. No toy packaging or base.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, including the space between arms and body. No background scene, no colored backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no ground plane, no desk or monitor, no cast shadow outside the character.
Constraints: one character, one pose, no pose sheet, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Preserve transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single transparent PNG, waist-up seated robot host for a comedy hockey website.
Input images: Image 1 is the USER'S ART STYLE reference, a charming illustrated Warren Buffett robot. Closely match its illustrated cartoon robot visual language: bold dark contours, clean broad faceted silver metal panels, graphic cel shading with polished highlights, dark inset eye screens containing simple cyan luminous shapes, sculpted chunky white metal hair, and mechanical hinged jaw. NOT photorealistic, NOT human skin, NO flesh tones, NO realistic eyeballs, pupils, irises, lips, teeth, wrinkles or skin pores. It must look like a lovable illustrated MACHINE, not a human android.
Composition: one character, FRONT FACING, seated posture visible from head to waist with both complete forearms and relaxed robot hands in front as though resting at a desk. NO actual desk, chair, backdrop or props. Square canvas, centered head and torso, head top around 8%, eyes around 27%, waist around 92%. Entire hands and elbows must fit within frame, leave transparent padding at sides and top. Medium shot not a headshot. Broad robot shoulders and proportionally large expressive head. Neutral closed articulated mouth.
Rendering: high-quality polished 2.5D character illustration matching reference, crisp hand-drawn-looking dark outlines and deliberate graphic metal shapes, coherent soft light from upper left. True transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard or background shadow, no text, labels, logos or watermark.
Character: a DON CHERRY-inspired hockey commentator robot. Capture his likeness ONLY through iconic caricature cues: receding broad chrome crown, dramatic swept-back chunky white metal side hair, thick white angular eyebrow plates, long angular silver nose, broad square silver jaw and a small triangular white-metal chin tuft recalling his goatee. His face is fully SILVER METAL; simple cyan bars/rounded rectangles for eyes in black inset sockets. No glasses. Mildly stern, opinionated expression.
Signature costume: extravagant cherry-red suit jacket with LARGE bold GOLD and IVORY floral motifs, wide lapels, crisp white shirt and navy tie with gold diagonal stripes, white pocket square and tiny black lapel microphone. Stylized illustrated jacket material, not photographic fabric. Robot hands silver with dark knuckle gaps. Default relaxed hands near waist. This is the character master for an expressive reusable pose set.
